items.title: Heavy Industries Ministry Extends Global Tender Deadline for Rare Earth Magnet Manufacturing Scheme
items.summary: The Ministry of Heavy Industries has extended the bid submission timeline for its global tender under the Scheme to Promote Manufacturing of Sintered Rare Earth Permanent Magnet.
